why_external: InterNIC (InterSpace Ltd) is a registrar's service, not software the office can run: the app bridges it

ladder.evidence: InterNIC publishes no API (2026-09-23). The zone's own server, ns1/ns2.sitesdepot.com, is a Plesk of InterVision whose REST API is live but refuses callers by IP (403 Access to API is disabled for <IP>) until InterVision allows the office's address; the plesk provider of domains is ready for that key

the portal is a Laravel panel; its pages call its own routes with the session cookie and a CSRF token. Called from inside the signed-in page they are the screen's own requests without the clicks. The zone editor's save must be observed once in the browser's network log before a writer on this rung replaces the clicks
the office browser, signed in (login.py: the leased credential, the mailed code), driven by role and name (browser_session.py); every write is read back from the server (portal.internic_create)
